title: Yellow Peppered British Corn Skillet
description: A fermented and juicy British dish featuring yellow pepper and a mother-sauce-base, cooked in an iron teppan skillet, perfect for adventurous eaters. This egg-free-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional Cornish cuisine.
instructions: Heat the iron teppan skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Add the diced yellow pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the corn, mother sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the crumbly cornish yarg cheese until melted and well combined.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with additional yellow pepper slices if desired.
Let the skillet cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
